title: Strangers by the Moat
notes: Two visitors I met by the moat of the Forbidden City in the late-afternoon light: the first time I walked up to strangers and asked them to be my models.
lens: Tamron 25-200mm F/2.8-5.6 Di III VXD G2
alt: A woman in glasses and a burgundy shirt breathes out a cloud of smoke, a cigarette between her fingers, beside a smiling bearded man in a pale pink polo shirt; they stand at a railing by the moat, with a palace gate tower, red walls and tall pines behind them in warm evening light.
caption: Strangers by the Moat
